title: Truchas 2D coupled flow-thermal simulation input
description: Complete input for a two-dimensional non-isothermal flow simulation with thermal transport.

materials.description: Named material definitions used by the simulation. Without material-regions, define exactly one material.

material-regions.description: Optional geometric or cell-set assignment of materials to the mesh.

ht-model.description: Thermal model, including the advection-capable thermal boundary conditions and optional sources.

solver.description: Coupled flow and thermal solver controls.

initial-time.description: Simulation time at which the initial flow and temperature states are established. The default is zero.

output-times.description: Output schedule. At least one expanded output time must be later than initial-time.

final-time.description: Optional final simulation time. It must be greater than initial-time and no earlier than the last output time; if omitted, it equals the last output time.

time-stepping.description: Coupled-integrator time-step limits, synchronization, and retry controls.

initial-velocity.description: Optional initial velocity field. It may be a constant vector or inline vector function; it must evaluate to exactly two components. If omitted, the initial velocity is zero.

initial-temperature.description: Initial temperature field. It may be a constant or inline scalar function projected to mesh cell centers.
